copy_rules: Client copy is rendered ONLY from the client-safe park record (label, needed, waiting_on) and from verified delivery records. The raw blocked reason, park class names, phase ids, and AF codes never appear in client copy.

client_action parks speak to the client in plain words: what is needed, in the client's terms. operator_action and transient_infra parks send the client NOTHING as if it were their move (see silent_classes).
Every message the layer sends is recorded in the run record (conversation-receipt.json) before it counts as sent.

Consent posture on every form this system ships: all consent boxes required to proceed, unchecked by default, benefit-first copy (owner ruling, 2026-10-13). The front door captures the conversation consent posture; it never re-asks a captured posture.

booking.ask: Would you like me to book your review call now? I will offer you a few times and confirm the one you pick.
booking.machinery: Booked through Skill 44 calendars under Skill 38's smart-booking protocol (protocols/smart-booking-protocol.md); any workflow created goes through Skill 44 and must pass the TRINITY gate.

delivery_followup.boundary: This is the CONVERSATIONAL follow-up only. The email sequence half of post-delivery follow-up is an election under FIX-PLAN Item 33c (Skill 50), deployed draft-only through Skill 44 after human approval; it is not part of this seam and no email is sent from here.

touches.template: Your presentation is ready, and thank you for trusting us with it. Final quality score: {qc_score}/10. You will find it at: {destinations}. Everything is confirmed in place. Take a look when you are ready, and tell me what you think.
touches.when: At verified delivery (after the delivery notification, SOP 9.3)

touches.template: A quick check-in on your presentation package: did everything open and play the way you expected? If anything looks off, tell me here and we will make it right.
touches.when: One follow-up window later (Skill 38 quiet hours and the F15 frequency cap govern the exact send time)

touches.template: When you are ready, I can book a short review call so we walk through the deck together and note anything you want adjusted. Just say the word and I will offer you times.
touches.when: After T2, once, then the sequence ends

frontdoor.greeting: Hello, and welcome. I help get presentations started here. If you would like a presentation built for you, I can get you to the right place in about a minute.
frontdoor.handoff: Perfect, that is everything I need. Your intake is ready here: {intake_link}. The intake walks you through the presentation questions one at a time, and everything you enter there goes straight into your build. I will be back here if anything pauses along the way.
frontdoor.not_qualified: No problem at all. If a presentation is not what you were after today, nothing has been started and there is nothing to cancel. If you change your mind, just come back and say hello.
qualification: Just to make sure I point you the right way: you are here because you would like a presentation created for you, is that right?
And you are the person this presentation is for (or you are arranging it for them)?

Last thing from me: is it all right for us to keep this conversation going here about your presentation, including follow-ups by message? Once you confirm, I will hand you straight to the intake, which is where the presentation questions themselves live.

by_need.resource_plan: Your presentation is paused. {needed} Just reply here with your answer and the work picks right back up. Everything you already sent us is saved.
by_need.style_pick: Your presentation is paused. {needed} Just reply here with A, B or C and the work picks right back up. Everything you already sent us is saved.

park_notice.client_action: Your presentation is paused. {needed} Everything you already sent us is saved, and the work done so far is kept.
park_notice.resumed: Thank you. We have what we need and your presentation is moving again. We will let you know as soon as the next step is ready.

silent_classes.operator_action: NO client message. The wait belongs to the operating team; the operator is notified through the existing park machinery (auto_resume notify_park_wait). The run record states the client surface was silent and why.
silent_classes.transient_infra: NO client message. A temporary problem is retrying on its own under the bounded auto-resume cadence; there is nothing for the client to do and nothing to ask them for.
